'''Himher''' was a [[Dealer droid/Legends|dealer droid]] that worked in the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Farpoint]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]] in the year [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. It was the dealer in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game in which [[Khedryn Faal]], [[Earsh]], [[Flaygin]], and [[Reegas Vance]] were all players. Himher was named for its voice which, by some manufacturing defect, changed from that of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] to that of a female mid sentence.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Himher appeared in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s first ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel, ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', which was published on [[January 26]], [[2010]].
